body.intent: Usage governor: the daemon paces itself to a usage reserve. It reads usage per window from the Claude Code adapter's token records, holds new picks (with a skip reason in daemon status, health and inbox) when projected use would eat into a configured reserve (a daemon setting), and resumes when the window resets (internal/api/daemon.go, internal/adapter/claudecode). Carve the existing leaf capability usage-governor out of umbrella 01M5SWTC1923N3 (Area orchestration) into this change set rather than adding a duplicate
